decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 15 April 2005, the erection of a roof extension, comprising a hip to gable conversion measuring 2.45 metres perpendicular height, 3.35 metres wide and 7.8 metres deep, a rear dormer in two sections measuring 4.2 metres wide, 2.45 metres overall height and 3.86 metres projection at top and 1.12 metres wide, 2.1 metres overall height and 3.2 projection at top and three roof lights to front elevation was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development does not fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the extension would extend beyond the plane of an existing roof slope which fronts a highway.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension to house.
